title: 衔接
goal: 能按补充、转折、因果、举例和让步关系组织句子，并用明确指代与关键词保持连贯。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 写作

points.label: 按逻辑关系选择连接词
用指代和关键词保持连贯

sources.title: ETS：TOEFL iBT Test 2026 Update — Test Blueprint and Specifications
sources.used: 题量、计分上限、测什么能力

sources.title: ETS：Updated TOEFL iBT Test Overview
sources.used: 题目说明、限时、官方样题和 5 分样例的评语

sources.title: ETS：Writing Scoring Guide — Write for an Academic Discussion
sources.used: 0–5 分每一档的描述（本课是中文转述，原文以官方为准）

sources.title: ETS：TOEFL iBT Writing Lesson Plans（教师用教案）
sources.used: 第 1 课（题目说明和答案页），第 4 课（在讨论区发帖要做的三件事），第 5 课（样题与样例）

body.p: 连贯靠两点：句子之间的逻辑关系清楚，每个代词指什么清楚。连接词标出句子之间已有的关系。无关的细节加上连接词，也不会变成理由或例子。

body.box: The registration form requires an access code. Some applicants have not received one. Therefore, they cannot complete the form yet.

body.p: one 指 access code，they 指 some applicants。Therefore 引出结果：没收到代码的人暂时不能填完表格。换成 For example，结果就被写成了例子。

cards.title: 连接词与标点
rows: 补充
Moreover、In addition 后加逗号，补充同一方向的信息。
The form is brief. Moreover, it can be saved before submission.
转折
However 后加逗号，引出与前句相对的信息。
The form is brief. However, it requires an access code.
因果
Therefore、As a result 后面是结果，不是原因。
The code is missing. Therefore, submission is impossible.
举例
For example 后加逗号，后面举例说明前句。
Some fields need clarification. For example, applicants may not recognize the course codes.
让步
Although 后接从句，主句不再加 but。
Although the form is brief, some fields are unclear.
句间转折
however 前后是两个完整句时，前面用句号或分号，不用逗号。
The form is brief; however, it requires a code.
并列转折
but 可连接两个分句，前面可加逗号。
The form is brief, but it requires a code.
原因从句
because 引出原因。because 从句不能单独成句。
Submission is impossible because the code is missing.

cards.title: 指代与关键词
rows: it
指单数对象。前面有两个名词都能指时，直接写出名词。
The form has a deadline. It must be submitted today. → The form must be submitted today.
they / them
指复数对象。作主语用 they，作宾语用 them。
Applicants receive codes and enter them on the form.
this + 名词
概括前面说的行为或结果，比单用 this 清楚。
Applicants must request a code first. This requirement delays registration.
重复关键词
重复关键名词，对象保持不变。不必为了避免重复而换词。
The form requests a course code. The code identifies the selected course.
概括名词
process、change 等名词要和前面的内容对得上。
The office removed an unnecessary field. This change shortened the form.
多个指代对象
代词可能指两个对象时，重复名词。
Applicants ask tutors about coordinators. They reply later. → The tutors reply later.

body.box: Draft: The arts center added a second entrance. For example, visitors no longer have to walk around the building. The entrances are near the ticket booths. They need clearer signs.

body.p: 第二句是增设入口的结果，不是入口的例子，For example 应改为 As a result。末句的 They 可能指 entrances，也可能指 ticket booths。要按作者的原意写明对象。

body.box:
Intended meaning: The entrances need clearer signs.
Revision: The arts center added a second entrance. As a result, visitors no longer have to walk around the building. The entrances are near the ticket booths. Both entrances need clearer signs.

body.p: Both entrances 重复关键词，排除了 booths。不能为了少重复而保留指代不清的代词。As a result 前后都是完整句，不能只用逗号连接。

body.box:
Which change preserves the intended relationships?
1. Treat the shorter walk as an example and signs as a result.
2. Treat the shorter walk as a result and name the entrances explicitly.
3. Treat the shorter walk as a contrast and identify the ticket booths.
4. Treat the shorter walk as an addition and leave both referents possible.

body.p: 第二项把走路变短写成结果，并写明需要标识的是入口。

groups.text:
Post: The mentoring scheme offers support to new volunteers. It also gives experienced volunteers a chance to review their own methods.
Intended relation: The second sentence adds another benefit.

items.stem: Which revision explicitly marks that relation?
options: However, experienced volunteers can also review their methods.
Therefore, new volunteers have already reviewed their methods.
For example, experienced volunteers need support from newcomers.
Moreover, experienced volunteers can reassess their own methods.
items.why: also gives ... a chance 表示另一项好处；Moreover 保留补充关系，没有把它改成因果或例子。

groups.text:
Post: The lecture hall's main door is locked. Students must use the side entrance.
Intended relation: The second fact is a consequence of the first.

items.stem: Which revision signals the intended consequence?
options: As a result, students need to enter through the side door.
For example, students have to come in by the side entrance.
However, students still find the main door open.
Moreover, students may also enter through the main door.
items.why: main door is locked 与 must use the side entrance 构成原因和结果，As a result 保留这一方向。

groups.text: Post: Several changes would make the application clearer. The office could replace unexplained abbreviations with full names.

items.stem: Which version presents the second idea as an example?
options: Therefore, the office must replace every abbreviation in the application.
For example, the office could write out names now shown as abbreviations.
However, the office could replace the unexplained abbreviations with full names.
Nevertheless, full names would make the application less clear.
items.why: replace unexplained abbreviations with full names 是 Several changes 中具体的一项，应标为举例，即第二项。第三项内容相同，但用 However 标成了转折。

groups.text:
Post: The tutors sent the students a schedule. They revised it after the students reported a clash.
Intended meaning: The tutors revised the schedule.

items.stem: Which revision makes the intended agent explicit?
options: The students revised the schedule after reporting the clash.
The students revised the schedule after the tutors reported a clash.
The tutors revised the schedule after receiving the students' report.
The tutors and the students revised the schedule together after the clash.
items.why: Intended meaning 指明修改日程的是 The tutors。第三项写出 tutors 和 schedule，消除了 They 的歧义。

groups.text: Post: Applicants must now upload proof of residence before choosing an appointment. This requirement may delay booking.

items.stem: What does This requirement refer to?
options: Choosing an appointment before supplying proof
The obligation to supply proof before selecting a time
The delay caused by selecting several appointments
The need to replace residence documents after booking
items.why: This requirement 概括前句的 must now upload proof ... before choosing an appointment。第二项保留了先交证明、后选时间的顺序。

groups.text: Post: The institute introduced a certificate for completed workshops. The certificate lists the skills practiced in each workshop.

items.stem: Why is repeating certificate useful here?
options: It introduces a different award for every skill.
It moves the topic from the certificate to the workshops.
It avoids stating what the workshops teach.
It keeps the newly introduced document as the topic.
items.why: The certificate lists ... 继续说明前句引入的同一证书；重复关键词维持对象一致。

items.stem: The new timetable offers more departures, but staffing remains a concern.
items.why: Although 引出让步从句，逗号后进入主句；主句不能再加 but。

items.stem: An evening class was canceled because too few people enrolled.
items.why: because 后是原因从句 too few people had enrolled；therefore 不能插入同一结构代替原因。

items.stem: The council removed the fee for neighborhood meeting rooms; the writer calls this a change.
items.why: This change 指取消费用；allows residents to book a room 用具体结果延续同一对象。

items.stem: The office issued temporary access cards and explained that the cards expire at noon.
items.why: The cards that the office issued 明确到期对象；are due to expire 表示预定到期。

groups.text:
Post: The debate society now publishes a summary after each meeting. Absent members can follow the discussion without asking another member to repeat it. The summaries and meeting notices appear on the same page. They should include the main arguments, according to the writer.
Intended meaning: Publishing summaries enables absent members to follow the discussion; summaries should contain the main arguments.

items.stem: Which revision explicitly marks the result in the second sentence?
options: However, absent members can follow the discussion without asking for a recap.
For example, absent members can follow the discussion without asking for a recap.
Therefore, absent members can keep up without requesting a personal recap.
Moreover, absent members can read the meeting notices on the same page.
items.why: Publishing summaries enables ... 说明两句是因果关系。第三项用 Therefore 引出结果。

items.stem: Which revision removes the ambiguity in They while preserving the intended meaning?
options: The summaries should present the discussion's central arguments.
The meeting notices should present the discussion's central arguments.
Both page elements should contain identical discussion arguments.
The absent members should submit their own discussion arguments.
items.why: Intended meaning 明确 summaries should contain the main arguments，重复 summaries 排除了 notices 和 members。

groups.text:
Post: A university offers access to a collection of recorded pronunciation exercises. The collection is extensive. Some recordings are difficult to hear. The university is replacing those recordings. This improvement should make the exercises more usable.
Intended relation: The audio problem limits the benefit of the large collection.

items.stem: Which sentence correctly expresses that contrast?
options: The collection is extensive because all recordings are difficult to hear.
Although the collection is extensive, some recordings are hard to hear.
For example, an extensive collection means its recordings are hard to hear.
The collection is extensive; therefore, every recording is difficult to hear.
items.why: The audio problem limits the benefit 是让步关系。第二项用 Although 引出让步，从句和主句之间用逗号。

items.stem: What does This improvement refer to?
options: Expanding the collection with more difficult exercises
Offering recordings without replacing unclear audio
Increasing the number of recordings in the collection
Replacing the recordings whose audio is hard to hear
items.why: The university is replacing those recordings 是 improvement 概括的行为，those recordings 指难以听清的录音。

items.stem: A proposed school lunch plan is affordable, yet its menu is limited.
items.why: Although 引出让步；逗号后的 its menu 是主句主语，不能同时加入 but。

items.stem: Staff cannot evaluate a request until the required diagram is attached.
items.lead: Staff cannot evaluate the request because
items.why: because 引出不能评估的原因；has not been attached 保留缺少附件的状态。

items.stem: The new rules require volunteer guides to complete an orientation; this requirement affects their start date.
items.why: This requirement 概括先完成培训的规定，means that 后准确写出其影响。

items.stem: An adviser discusses a course and its assessment guide; only the guide contains sample answers.
items.why: 明确重复 The assessment guide，避免 it 在 course 与 guide 之间产生歧义；contains 是主句谓语。
